overview_description.description:
Repeat offers restaurant customers the ability to search, discover, pay and get personalized rewards based on their loyalty - the only restaurant app that proposes all of these features in one single platform in the UAE and now also in the US (starting in Texas). Appealing to a new generation of restaurant lovers, Repeat offers a personalized experience unique to each user thanks to its advanced
filtering system for easier discovery of restaurants and its disruptive behavior-based reward system.
With more data generated from these features than any other app in the industry, Repeat is actively solving one of the largest unfulfilled restaurant problems in the World: data-driven marketing to generate incremental revenue.

about_short_description.short_description: Repeat App is at the forefront of consumer-driven restaurant tech, integrating discovery, mobile payment and loyalty into one platform.

product.name: Restaurant Directory & Guide
product.description: A comprehensive directory that allows users to search, sort, and filter through a wide selection of restaurants based on their preferences.

product.name: Offers & Rewards
product.description: Provides information on current offers and promotions at partner restaurants and offers personalized rewards based on user frequency.

product.name: Repeat Pay
product.description: A feature that enables secure and fast in-app payments for meals at partner restaurants, eliminating the need for physical credit cards.

product.name: Personalized Feed
product.description: A tailored feed that presents restaurant recommendations based on the user's location and preferences.

product.name: Homepage Scroller
product.description: A feature that allows users to browse through an extensive list of partner restaurants.

product.name: Filtering Options
product.description: Provides various filtering options to refine restaurant searches based on categories like cuisine type, experiences, and amenities.
